snapshot.title: Tutorial stalls on 'Select Target' when launch uses fallback auto-selection
snapshot.description: When the user presses Launch without explicitly clicking a target in the selector panel, LaunchpadLaunchButton calls ensure_selected_target_for_launch which auto-selects a fallback target. This does NOT call record_tutorial_action('select_launch_target'), so the tutorial remains stuck on the 'Select Target' step even after the rocket is in flight. This is the direct cause of the screenshot bug where the rocket is en route but the tutorial panel shows 'Select Target / Mission 1'.
